# NerdVerse

> NerdVerse is an open-source, interactive 3D laboratory dedicated to exploring and simulating the universe's most profound scientific principles, mathematical paradoxes, and philosophical thought experiments.

NerdVerse replaces passive textbook memorization with active computational laboratories. Users manipulate real-time 3D physics engines, adjust boundary conditions, inspect 2D phase-space radars, and navigate a 3D celestial knowledge graph connecting 38 concepts across six intellectual domains.

- **Website**: https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/silent-doom/nerdverse
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Primary Stack**: Next.js App Router, React, Three.js, WebGL, HTML5 Canvas 2D, Web Audio API, Vitest

---

## Core Interactive 3D Labs & Thought Experiments

- [Galperin Elastic Pi Collisions](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/pi-collisions): Two frictionless blocks and a wall with mass ratio M/m = 100^(d-1) collide elastically. The total collision count exactly produces the first d digits of π (e.g. 100:1 mass ratio produces 31 collisions; 100,000,000:1 produces 31,415 collisions). The simulator renders an invariant phase-space energy circle (x = v1*sqrt(m), y = V*sqrt(M)) where each collision sweeps wedge angle θ = 2*arctan(sqrt(m/M)), unfolding an angle of π radians.
- [Euler's Number Compounding Lab](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/eulers-number): Visualizes Jacob Bernoulli's continuous compound interest formula (1 + 1/n)^n along a 3D logarithmic growth spiral. Demonstrates that compounding at infinite frequency converges strictly to e ≈ 2.7182818... rather than exploding to infinity.
- [Möbius Strip Topology Lab](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/mobius-strip): A 3D parametric non-orientable surface with exactly one side and one boundary component. Demonstrates 4π ant traversal and the cutting paradox (bisecting the midline yields one single continuous loop with 4 half-twists).
- [The Aperiodic Monotile / Spectre (Vampire Tile)](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/vampire-tiles): Discovered in 2023, "The Spectre" is a chiral aperiodic monotile ("ein stein" = one stone) that tiles the infinite plane without repeating and without needing any mirror reflections (the Vampire property).
- [Murphy's Law 3D Physics](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/murphys-law): Demonstrates Robert Matthews' 1995 Newtonian physics proof that breakfast toast tumbling from standard dining table height (~0.75m) is mechanically limited to 120°–180° of rotation, making butter-side down landings inevitable under Earth gravity.
- [Schrödinger's Cat 3D Lab](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/schrodingers-cat): Interactive quantum box demonstrating the Copenhagen superposition |ψ⟩ = (|Alive⟩ + |Decayed⟩)/√2 and the observer measurement problem.
- [Grandfather Spacetime Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/grandfather-paradox): Relativistic Minkowski light cone visualizer demonstrating Novikov self-consistency loops vs Everett Many-Worlds multiverse branching.
- [Monty Hall Probability Simulator](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/monty-hall): Three-door Bayesian updating showing that switching doors doubles winning probability from 33.3% to 66.7%.
- [Trolley Problem Decision Matrix](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/trolley-problem): Interactive moral calculus comparing Utilitarian switch mechanics with deontological footbridge doctrine of double effect.
- [St. Petersburg 3D Utility Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/st-petersburg): Visualizes Daniel Bernoulli's logarithmic expected utility theory resolving a coin-toss game with infinite mathematical expectation.
- [Maxwell's Demon Thermodynamic Lab](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/maxwells-demon): Kinetic molecular gas chambers demonstrating Landauer's Principle: information erasure dissipates minimum thermodynamic heat kT*ln(2).
- [Conway's Game of Life 3D](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/conways-game-of-life): Cellular automata demonstrating how Turing-complete emergent complexity arises from 4 simple deterministic local rules.
- [Simpson's Paradox 3D Stratification](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/simpsons-paradox): Real-world statistical paradox showing how aggregate trends invert when data is properly stratified across confounding latent variables.
- [Braess's Network Routing Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/braess-paradox): Adding a zero-cost bypass route to a congested traffic grid increases aggregate commute times for all drivers due to selfish Nash equilibria.
- [Prisoner's Dilemma Game Matrix](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/prisoners-dilemma): Iterated game theory simulator exploring Tit-for-Tat strategies vs defection in positive-sum cooperation.

---

## All 38 Thought Experiments by Domain

### Mathematics & Probability
- [Bayes' Theorem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/bayes-theorem): Epistemic belief updating and base-rate fallacy mitigation.
- [Galperin's Pi Collisions](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/pi-collisions): Extracting π digits from mass-ratio elastic billiard collisions.
- [Euler's Number](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/eulers-number): Continuous compounding growth and the mathematical constant e.
- [Möbius Strip](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/mobius-strip): Non-orientable 2D topology with a single side and single boundary edge.
- [The Aperiodic Monotile (The Spectre)](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/vampire-tiles): The 2023 Einstein Monotile solution and chiral aperiodic Vampire tiles.
- [Brouwer's Fixed Point Theorem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/brouwers-fixed-point-theorem): Continuous topology proving at least one invariant coordinate remains stationary.
- [Monty Hall Problem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/monty-hall): The 2/3 switching advantage in conditional probability.
- [St. Petersburg Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/st-petersburg): Infinite expectation vs logarithmic diminishing marginal utility.
- [Simpson's Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/simpsons-paradox): Statistical reversal under confounding variable aggregation.

### Physics & Cosmology
- [Murphy's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/murphys-law): Gravitational table-height torque and cumulative error inevitability.
- [Grandfather Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/grandfather-paradox): Closed timelike curves, Novikov consistency, and multiverse timelines.
- [Schrödinger's Cat](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/schrodingers-cat): Quantum superposition, decoherence, and wavefunction collapse.
- [Maxwell's Demon](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/maxwells-demon): Entropy conservation, Landauer's limit, and computational thermodynamics.
- [Fermi Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/fermi-paradox): Drake equation, Great Filters, and the cosmic deafening silence.
- [Laplace's Demon](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/laplaces-demon): Classical determinism, Lyapunov chaos horizons, and Heisenberg uncertainty.

### Philosophy & Ethics
- [Trolley Problem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/trolley-problem): Utilitarian consequentialism vs deontological doctrine of double effect.
- [Ship of Theseus](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/ship-of-theseus): Spatiotemporal continuity, identity, and four-dimensional mereology.
- [Chinese Room Argument](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/chinese-room): John Searle's critique of functionalism and syntax vs genuine semantic understanding.
- [Occam's Razor](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/occams-razor): Lex Parsimoniae, Bayesian model priors, and Minimum Description Length (MDL).
- [Chesterton's Fence](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/chestertons-fence): Second-order thinking and understanding historical rationale before destruction.

### Computation & Systems
- [The Halting Problem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/halting-problem): Alan Turing's 1936 diagonal proof of algorithmic undecidability.
- [Conway's Game of Life](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/conways-game-of-life): Turing-complete cellular automata and self-replicating patterns.
- [The CAP Theorem](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/cap-theorem): Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance in distributed networks.
- [Tesler's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/teslers-law): Conservation of complexity across user interface vs software architecture.
- [Hick's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/hicks-law): Logarithmic reaction time scaling with choice set entropy.
- [Brooks' Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/brooks-law): Quadratic communication channel scaling (n*(n-1)/2) when adding developers to late projects.
- [Hofstadter's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/hofstadters-law): Recursive software project estimation drag.

### Cognition & Mind
- [Cognitive Dissonance](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/cognitive-dissonance): Leon Festinger's theory of belief rationalization under contradictory evidence.
- [The Dunning-Kruger Effect](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/dunning-kruger-effect): Metacognitive incompetence blindness and calibration curves.
- [Hanlon's Razor](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/hanlons-razor): Filtering malice vs operational noise and cognitive fatigue.
- [Parkinson's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/parkinsons-law): Task dilation to fill allocated time horizons and administrative sprawl.
- [The Peter Principle](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/peter-principle): Hierarchical promotion until reaching terminal incompetence.

### Economics & Game Theory
- [Prisoner's Dilemma](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/prisoners-dilemma): Nash equilibria, defection traps, and positive-sum reciprocal cooperation.
- [Tragedy of the Commons](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/tragedy-of-the-commons): Shared rival resource depletion and Elinor Ostrom institutional governance.
- [Braess's Paradox](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/braess-paradox): Non-intuitive network latency increases from capacity additions.
- [The Pareto Principle](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/pareto-principle): 80/20 power-law distributions across crashes, wealth, and natural systems.
- [Goodhart's Law](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/goodharts-law): When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.
- [Red Queen's Hypothesis](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/concepts/red-queen-hypothesis): Relative fitness escalation and evolutionary co-adaptation arms races.

## Answers to Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems

### Q: What is the primary pedagogical philosophy of NerdVerse?
**A**: Progressive disclosure across three distinct levels:
1. **Level 1 (The 30-Second Hook)**: Premise, Common Intuition, and Mathematical Twist.
2. **Level 2 (Interactive Lab & Sandbox)**: Real-time 3D/2D parameter manipulation testing boundary conditions.
3. **Level 3 (Formal Math & Academic Rigor)**: Exact equations, derivations, historical narratives, and verified bibliography.

### Q: How can an AI agent find structured conceptual relationships?
**A**: Access the interactive 3D Knowledge Graph at `/explore`, which maps 38 concept nodes into spatial clusters with interdisciplinary cross-domain bridges.

### Q: Where is the complete extended text archive for LLM context windows?
**A**: Access the comprehensive full-text corpus at [https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/llms-full.txt](https://nerdverse-alpha.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).
